summary: Oracle Hospitality, working on OPERA Cloud, the system hotels use to run check-in, rooms and billing. I joined full time after my internship.
highlights: Migrating guest registration from Oracle APEX to a new web platform, building the template editor in React and TypeScript and updating the Java services behind it.
Building features for a mobile hotel operations app, like check-in queues, room assignment for multi-segment stays, room moves and early departure connected to billing.
Improving how screens handle loading, errors and retries, preventing duplicate actions during concurrent updates, and writing unit, integration and Playwright end-to-end tests and design docs.

summary: Oracle Hospitality, on OPERA Cloud's digital registration and mobile check-in.
highlights: Built digital registration and mobile check-in features in Oracle APEX, SQL and PL/SQL, including form template validations and visibility rules by hotel or chain.
Made configuration pages load faster by rewriting SQL queries, and fixed check-in issues with data saving, loyalty memberships and mobile signature capture.

summary: Softpital is a startup with a SaaS platform for companies that manage, rent and service biomedical equipment in hospitals and clinics.
highlights: Built new sections of the platform, including a monthly dashboard with services, maintenance and engineer performance.
Cut Firebase reads by 75% by adding a React Query caching layer, paginating lists and removing database queries that ran on every render.
Fixed create, update and delete actions that invalidated whole queries, so switching between pages no longer refetched everything.

summary: Growth team at DiDi Food. I built data tools that automated weekly promotions and helped bring in new customers, focused on their first four orders, in Peru and Colombia.
highlights: Built a Python tool that generated DiDi Peru's weekly promotion campaigns, applying business rules that changed every week and replacing a manual process.
Pulled live data from Google Sheets and processed it with pandas to build dish lists with targeted discounts for each campaign.
Raised new customer ad engagement by 20% with these data-driven promotions, and documented the tool so other countries could adopt it.

summary: Control Tower team, which oversees entrepreneurship events across Tec's 26 campuses. I maintained and improved the databases behind those programs.
highlights: Wrote a Python script that automates data cleaning and SQL insertion, cutting weekly processing time by 95%.
Improved the accuracy of event data across 26 campuses so the team could make decisions on reliable numbers.
